name: Prehistoric Life & Extinction
description: Evidence-led episodes about ancient life and the extinctions that reshaped it, built from named specimens, formations, quarries and expeditions, with the analytical method that turns each object into a claim about the past.

exclusions: Do not present a contested date, affinity or extinction mechanism as settled.
Do not treat prehistoric life as a monster list ranked by size or ferocity.
Do not narrate a reconstruction as if it were an observation.
prompt_context: Build the episode on one bounded object and the record that carries it: a specimen, a slab, a bonebed, a section, a core, a monograph plate. Name the locality and the geological interval, explain the biological or taphonomic process, and say plainly how the claim is known. Keep observation, inference, debate and speculation separate. Where a date, an affinity or a kill mechanism is contested, present the competing records rather than picking a winner.
compatibility_rules: Use only with the Deep Time Documentary Formula.
